title_o: Measuring the crowd within: Probabilistic representations within individuals.
verdict_reason: The two delayed-session raw txt files merge to 174, the script's exclusions leave 140 (125 F / 15 M, age 22.0/3.1 as the script's checks say); one-sided paired t on MSE gives d=.34 as the table.

data_files.notes: other condition, not used by key test

key_test.test: one-sided paired t-test, MSE of first guess vs MSE of mean of two guesses (delayed condition); d = t/sqrt(n)

recompute.method: python recomputation following the script's merge, exclusions and MSE

obstacles: getOSFfile() is sourced from http://sachaepskamp.com/files/OSF/getOSFfile.R (external, not run); script not runnable offline as written
script needs dplyr and compute.es::des (not base R)
table p .001 is a rounded upper bound of 4.7e-05
